title: Zora Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Zora Spear Icon.png |caption= A Zora Spear |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Zora Set]] |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Zora Gear|Zora Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 173}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Zora Gear is weaponry crafted by the [[Zora]]. It is made out of a particular type of silver metal that grants it increased durability and lightness.{{Cite|{{Big|Zora Sword}}
The ornamentation that adorns this blade is a traditional Zora design. It's forged from a very durable and rust-proof metal.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Zora Spear}}
This spear is a Zora's weapon of choice. It's lighter than it looks due to being made from a special metal and is used by the Zora for both fishing and protecting their domain.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Silver Bow}}
A bow favored by the Zora for fishing. It doesn't boast the highest firepower, but the special metal it's crafted from prioritizes durability.|Inventory|BotW}} In addition to combat, some of these items are traditionally used for fishing. Since all pieces of Zora Gear are made out of metal, they will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, Zora Gear will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Zora Sword Icon.png|link=]]
